'''The Oarsman's Pride''' is an [[inn]] in [[Ebou Dar]]. It is near the [[River Eldar]]. Nothing is known about the appearance of the inn.

When [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] is crossing the river, [[Moghedien]] uses [[balefire]] on her boat from the top of The Oarsman's Pride.{{ref/book|7|30}}
